body:
Actual replacement17 CF10 public-configuration adoption reached the complete installed `/usr/share/post-update` entrypoint and returned 1: `cp: can't stat '/usr/config/melondDS': No such file or directory`. Distribution `3756fde50e52b71b101a892a5b2862b708ad7b32`; immutable bundle `5f7b86dcd8ab4b54c2a97b6c7217eadc55031050a0e4c5e407b374627ba0c160`; original watched owner `public-adoption01` under `/workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-cf10-17/`. Preserve the failed aggregate and completed explicit-root/custom-library cloud cases separately.

This is a previously recorded upstream observation, now an actual installed failure: #258's 2026-09-24 audit punch-list recorded the misspelling. Source archaeology identifies upstream `62c343921d8aa21dab6ccd6574017d4223326c9a` (2026-09-06). The block unconditionally deletes `/storage/.config/melonDS` before copying from a misspelled source. The package installs `/usr/config/melonDS`; GENERIC_X64 does not ship that standalone package at all. The launcher seeds missing files but cannot recover deleted owner settings.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes: the shipped hook, absent optional package, synthetic older/custom INI files, new hotkey defaults, repeated application, and write/read failures are software behavior. No physical device or personal cloud action is needed.

Already written: older updates may have deleted melonDS configuration; deleted unknown values cannot be reconstructed. Preserve all configuration still present, add missing shipped hotkey defaults without resetting owner choices, and let clean installs/launchers retain their existing seeding contract. Do not invent recovered settings.

Acceptance criteria:
- [x] Retain original installed failure, source intent/history and a discriminating negative control showing old code deletes a synthetic owner sentinel or fails when the optional package is absent.
- [x] Fix the update hook so an absent optional package is a successful no-op; existing settings/extra files/symlinks remain intact; required missing hotkey defaults are added atomically and idempotently; failed preparation preserves originals. Retain focused host/actual-VM receipts and source hashes.
- [x] Verify the complete corrected post-update entrypoint on the VM with public ROCKNIX cloud config/filter seeds; cloud paths, credentials, automatic-sync choices and local/cloud payload hashes remain unchanged. Preserve failed attempts as failed.
- [x] Publish the scoped fix, appropriate review and checks, then include it in a newly frozen engineering image and repeat affected installed qualification before H700/SM8550 or an RC claim. Update #508, M7, the work/friction logs and session checkpoint with exact evidence.

Ordered dependency: #508 installed CF10 qualification → this correction/new image inclusion → final VM/protocol qualification → H700 → SM8550. #519 remains mandatory before any owner handheld update. No repeated external #507 audit or transfer approval is implied.


Completed 2026-10-08: scoped source fix published at `7f58b7b1c592908dcd0ba5987955e59aaa79fe66`; installed/update evidence published at `bde89e16f71daa51f1720352f0a0dfa45374b5e7`. Both exact-head hosted checks succeeded. [Replacement18 evidence](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/bde89e16f71daa51f1720352f0a0dfa45374b5e7/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-pixelelated-replacement-18) binds the immutable bundle, matching disk/update SYSTEM, installed hook hash, three public-configuration cases, and the complete installed hook twice. All 15 actual BusyBox preservation/failure controls pass; original replacement17 failure and all 15 old-source negative controls remain retained. Bounded local implementation review is recorded; no new independent audit is claimed.

The real candidate16-to-replacement18 retained-storage update passes 31 checks, including owner melonDS INI/extra files/private mode, save bytes, cloud credentials/paths, settings, and startup completion. The 321-file CF10 and 33-file upgrade packets preserve original commands/results and owner-exit acceptance. Public ROCKNIX configuration adoption is distinct from fork-image upgrade; no upstream GENERIC_X64 image is claimed. Test runtimes were retired after compact evidence acceptance.

The standard scripts suite on installed replacement18 also passed at 19:58 UTC. Remaining final VM/protocol qualification and the independent test-navigation mismatch #527 belong to #508, not an unresolved melonDS defect. #508/M7 now order those before H700 then SM8550; #519 remains before owner deployment. No RC designation.
